messages:
Lina: quick postmortem follow-up from the flag-induced outage. i wrote a short remediation checklist we can act on this sprint.
Omar: thanks. main causes i saw: unscoped global flag + fast ramp + no quick-unpublish path.
Priya: agree. we should enforce safer defaults and add an automated rollback chain tied to combined signals.
Lina: proposed minimums: (a) default sample_scope = org_tag, (b) ramp steps 1% -> 5% -> 20% with minimum hold windows, (c) auto-pause when two signals cross thresholds, (d) auto-rollback if pause persists or error budget burns.
Omar: for signals: use ewma error_rate (3m), p95 latency delta (1.5x), and fallback failures. require at least two to trigger pause to avoid noise.
Priya: SDK change: add `fallback_variant` + `max_tokens_per_request` per-flag to limit token storms. i'll take this. ETA 2025-05-02.
Lina: infra: i will build a lightweight detector that emits `canary_health` and implements the two-signal rule. ETA 2025-05-06.
Omar: i'll add a small simulator to replay the incident and validate thresholds. path: `eng-platform/tools/canary_replay.sh`. ETA 2025-05-04.
deploy-bot: [ci] canary-guards/basic-tests passed on staging.
Priya: sample guard snippet for configs:
```
{"flag":"new-llm-route","scope":"org_tag","tag":"beta","sample_pct":1,"ramps_mins":[5,15,60],"auto_pause":{"ewma_mins":3,"err_pct":2,"latency_mult":1.5},"auto_rollback":{"pause_mins":10}}
```
Lina: action items: Lina -> detector + dashboard (due 2025-05-06); Omar -> sim harness + gating rules (due 2025-05-04); Priya -> SDK fallback + tokens cap PR (due 2025-05-02); Lina/Ops -> emergency unpublish UI spec (due 2025-05-09).
Omar: also recommend a policy: no flag can exceed 10% sample without explicit manual approval and documented risk sign-off.
Priya: monthly audit: list global flags and owners; auto-tag flags that haven't been scoped after 7 days for review.
Lina: i'll create the postmortem board cards and link them to the incident. card IDs: PM-4410 (detector), PM-4411 (sdk), PM-4412 (sim).
Omar: tagging remediation label `flag-blast` in the incident tracker for search.
Priya: small rollout plan: enable `mini` canary for 3 internal customers for 2 weeks, then widen.
Lina: thanks team. we'll reconvene in one week to review staging sims. :thumbsup:
